title: A weak or none pack prints the kb_feedback hint on servers that have no kb_feedback tool
goal: The feedback: hint line prints only where kb_feedback is served: a kb_http.py or --roots server, which does not list the tool, prints no hint, and plugin.md and token-efficiency.md say which servers print it; a test runs kb_pack on a limited server and asserts no hint line.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import kbcommon, kb_mcp; kbcommon.serve_only(['public']); r = kb_mcp.handle({'jsonrpc': '2.0', 'id': 1, 'method': 'tools/call', 'params': {'name': 'kb_pack', 'arguments': {'question': 'zzqx frobnicate the quux widget lattice'}}}); t = r['result']['content'][0]['text']; print(t.splitlines()[:3]); sys.exit(1 if 'feedback: kb_feedback' in t else 0)
